text: In the proof of Cantor's theorem, the diagonal set D = {x ∈ A : x ∉ f(x)} shows that the function f : A → 𝒫(A) cannot be a ___ (that is, cannot be onto).
explanation: Because D differs from f(y) for every y ∈ A, no element of A maps onto D, so f is not a surjection (not onto). This is exactly why |A| < |𝒫(A)|.
